question: Where does the native command the torpedo run-in altitude, and why do this host's aircraft hold 800 m when the release gate wants 25 to 40?
answer: Step 4 of the attackrun tick 009D07B0 - altitude approach+78h + approach+74h through 009FBA50 - is the only descent command in the whole torpedo chain. 009FBA50 clamps against Dynamics/Ceiling - 50 and calls 009FB800(clamped, unclamped); 009FB800 writes cmd+2BCh and cmd+2D0h = 2, with a dive arm gated and capped by desc+1F0h DropAngle against a DEG(60) floor and a climb arm that commands nothing because desc+1ECh has no producer in any shipped row. This host ran the state machine's per-state tick (009D48F6) for the aim state ONLY, so the attackrun tick never ran and no aircraft was ever told to descend; the binding command_altitude_and_throttle that attack_run_tick already calls was also an empty override. Both are fixed. USN01 goes from 0 torpedo drops to 5 with the rest of the mission unchanged to the tenth of a damage point. Still no swim: the aircraft overshoot the commanded 12 m to -400 m and release at -230 m, below the surface, because the climb arm commands nothing and this host has no ctl+FCh water arm to catch a plane at the surface.
coverage: complete for 009FBA50 and 009FB800 including the argument order at the join; PARTIAL for 009D07B0, of whose five steps only step 4's altitude half is run.

calls.what: the join: 009FBB06 stores the UNCLAMPED altitude as the second argument and 009FBB0C the clamped one as the first, checked against the push order

named_routines.name: BSP_PilotBot_CommandCruiseAltitude
named_routines.abi: float __thiscall(this, float base, float rangeLow, float rangeHigh, float scale), RET 10h, body 009FBA50-009FBB1C
named_routines.what: span = max(rangeHigh - rangeLow, 0); ceilingLimit = Dynamics/Ceiling - 50 [00CE3938], min'd with squadron+394h when there is a squadron; base += span * scale * class+518h when span > 0; then 009FB800(min(base, ceilingLimit), base). The attackrun tick passes rangeLow = rangeHigh = 0, so the gain term is unreachable on this path.

named_routines.name: BSP_PilotBot_CommandPitchFromAltitude
named_routines.abi: void __thiscall(this, float desiredAltitude, float reference), RET 8, body 009FB800-009FBA4F
named_routines.what: err = min(desired, Ceiling - 50) - unit+100h at 009FB849; x = err * ((reference + 1) * 0.5) at 009FB858. Climb (x > 0): min(class+1ECh * clamp(x/ClimbDist, 0, reference), max(class+1ECh * 1.6, DEG(40) [00CE7D20])). Dive: -min(class+1F0h DropAngle * clamp(-x/DropDist, 0, reference), max(DropAngle * 1.6, DEG(60) [00D05AAC])). Writes cmd+2BCh and cmd+2D0h = 2 on every path. class+1ECh has no producer in any shipped row, so the climb arm commands exactly zero - confirmed at run time, an aircraft below its commanded altitude gets 0.0000 and never recovers.

host_methods.host: the kAttackRun branch of the state tick dispatch
host_methods.note: 009D48F6 runs the current state's tick; this host ran aim only. Step 4's altitude half only; steps 1, 2, 3, 5 and step 4's throttle are not run.
was an empty override; now drives cruise_altitude_command_009fba50 then pitch_command_009fb800 into plan_state.pitch_target_2bc

authored_rows.file: run-time census, the USN01 Mav class

contracts: class+518h (009FBA50's per-class gain) and squadron+394h are unmodelled; neither is reachable on this path because the attackrun tick passes span = 0 and no aircraft here has a squadron.
cmd+2D0h = 2 is written but not acted on: 0099DCE0's mode-2 arm holds unit+C84h, which this host does not model.
Steps 1, 2, 3 and 5 of 009D07B0 and step 4's throttle half are not run.
ctl+FCh's ground arm 007DBEAA-007DC204 and water arm 007DC205-007DC68C do not exist in this host; free_flight_gate_00d06130_38 answers true for every plane forever.

corrections.is: step 4's altitude is the ONLY descent command in the torpedo chain, and the 009FB800 argument order at 009FBB03-009FBB13 is (clamped, unclamped)
corrections.evidence: 009FBB06, 009FBB0C, 009FBB13; 009D1EDD and 009D20B4 for the aim state's half

corrections.was: both rules recorded; the climb arm's zero gain argued from a .text scan
corrections.is: both bound and measured; the zero climb gain confirmed at run time, an aircraft below its commanded altitude gets 0.0000 and holds -400.6 m for the rest of the mission

validation.runner: tools/run_game.ps1, 3200 frames, --mission-frames 3000 at 0.05 s, from this worktree at 5407abbbb. The before column is the same source with the kAttackRun branch switched off by a temporary compile-time constant, removed before the commit. These baselines are NOT comparable with the previous packet's: the merge of main brought other workers' changes that moved USN01 from 1 hit and 9.3 damage to 68 and 660.0 before anything here ran.
validation.attribution: The descent is the whole change: USN01 goes from 0 torpedo drops to 5 while the mission's hits, kills and damage are identical to the tenth (68 / 3 / 660.0). The ordered aircraft close 207 m more because five of them now fly a real attack run. USN02 executed the new branch ZERO times - its log contains no descent census line and its own summary says no ordered aircraft carries torpedo ordnance - so identity there is established directly rather than by a second run; its difference from the previous packet's 161 hits is the merge of main.
validation.no_swim_next_gate: ctl+FCh and the water arm 007DC205-007DC68C, with the ground arm 007DBEAA-007DC204. The aircraft overshoots the commanded 12 m to -400 m and releases at -230 m, below the surface, so the round never crosses the water downward. Two image behaviours this host lacks combine: 009FB800's climb arm commands exactly zero because desc+1ECh has no producer, so nothing lifts an aircraft back to its commanded altitude, and free_flight_gate_00d06130_38 answers true forever so no plane ever leaves free flight for a contact arm. At the commanded 12 m the measured 55.68 m/s release would enter at 57.8 m/s against a 100.0 limit and the torpedo would swim. No ad-hoc altitude clamp was added, because the image does not have one.
